open_dynamic_minus_prepublished_exact.estimand: mean across complete-round differences of within-arm trial means (arm_a - arm_b)

reactive_exact_minus_open_dynamic.estimand: mean across complete-round differences of within-arm trial means (arm_a - arm_b)

missingness_policy: All scheduled trials remain in trial-level counts. A metric contrast excludes a complete design round only when either arm has a missing value for that metric; no value is imputed.

protocol.compiler_contract: all arms compile only routes captured from live Adj-RIB-In after observation
protocol.open_scope_contract: the signed policy and pretrial action map name neither endpoint origin
protocol.primary_endpoint: first successful data-plane probe after new-route Adj-RIB-In observation
protocol.randomization_unit: one arm block within each complete round
protocol.secondary_endpoint: configured usable routing action after new-route Adj-RIB-In observation
